 Kinds of Subordinate (Dependent Clause)
 1 Noun Clause – Functions as a noun (Subject / Object / Complement)
 Ex.1. What they say is true.

 (Noun Clause used as Subject)
 2. I know that she is honest.

 (Noun Clause used as Object)
 3. Her belief is that she will win.

 (Noun Clause as Complement)

 2 Adjective Clause (Relative Clause) – Modify a noun or pronoun.
 Ex. 1. The building that was constructed last year has collapsed.

 (Adjective Clause qualifying building) 

 2. The girl who won the prize is very intelligent.

 Ex. 1. I will come when you call me.

 (Adverb Clause qualifying come)
